newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Adare sees more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Adare sees more acquisitions.

text.p: Ireland's Adare Printing Group Plc said on Monday it would continue to make acquisitions to follow its strategic path of branded goods and services in niche print and stationery sectors.

"The group is assembling scale to its activities to ensure that it is a solid, cash-generative entity with a broad objective of achieving a 200 million Irish pound turnover by 1999," chairman Denis Bergin said in a results statement.
It reported full-year pre-tax profit to April 30 of 10.9 million Irish pounds, a 41 percent increase over its 7.7 million year-ago result.
Adare recommended a final net dividend per share up 50 percent to 4.479 pence.
Sales rose 65 percent from 70 million pounds to 116 million and earnings per share were up 30 percent from 53.38 pence to 69.33 pence.
In April Adare acquired the business and some of the assets of Platignum, the stationery division of Mentmore Abbey Plc for 1.35 million pounds sterling.
In May the group acquired Prontaprint Group Plc at a cost of 24 million pounds sterling.
